correctness.rationale: The augmented boundary of the full two-skeleton on seven Fano points contracts Λ³(Z^7) to Λ²(Z^7); the kernel is Λ³W of rank C(6,3)=20. Removing precisely seven collinear oriented triangles gives the quotient T of rank7. Every omitted line L admits a fourth point x, and ∂(L∪{x}) projects to ±[L] and no other omitted line, proving integral surjectivity and hence saturation, kernel rank13, H1=0. An independent group enumeration found all 168 invertible binary linear actions, 7 lines, stabilizer H of [1,2,3] of order24, five H-orbits on triples of sizes 1,12,6,12,4. Exactly three orbits support eta-twisted signed sums; their boundary vectors are (1,4,0) times ∂[123]. Thus every equivariant potential section coefficient is divisible by 4; u_12−4u_1 is an exact eta-cycle mapping to −4[L] and induces a global G-map of exponent4. Independent signed fixed-chain character enumeration (source proof logic and finite group check) yields H2 character 13,−3,1,1,−1,−1 and signed line character 7,−1,1,−1,0,0. The complex decomposition follows from the standard PSL2(7) table. The main novelty is integral nonsplitting; rational splitting follows by Maschke. No assertion about the order of an Ext-group class is made.
